E.detail: FIPS name gap (expected fail of strict FIPS-name acceptance — ships as found)

naming_gap_disclosure: LEG E: ML-DSA-65 (FIPS 204 name of Dilithium3), ML-KEM-1024 (FIPS 203 name of Kyber-1024), SLH-DSA-256f (FIPS 205 name of SPHINCS+-256f), and the fleet's own historical 'CRYSTALS-Kyber-1024' (July 2026 AegisAnomaly) are all REJECTED under byte-exact identification. These are the same algorithms under their published FIPS names. Ships as found: the standard draft includes a human-approved name-equivalence table (SIP-8); the gate is NOT silently patched, per Constitution Art. 2.2.
